value.name: Miles questions his actions
value.description: Miles silently reflects and asks himself whether he is going too far.
evidence: He stares contemplatively at the ceiling and, after a beat, responds to the silence: MILES Am I going to far here?

value.name: voice announces Meyerson's request
value.description: A female voice over the squawk box tells Miles that Herb Meyerson wants to see him.
evidence: A squawk box interrupts with a female voice. VOICE Mr. Massey, Mr. Meyerson would like to see you when you have a moment.

value.name: Miles reacts with surprise
value.description: Miles is surprised to hear that Herb Meyerson wants to see him.
evidence: MILES Herb wants to see me?
